findings.title: Data race on shared counter and error in parallel index init
findings.body: In searchSupport.init the errgroup goroutine does totalBatchesIndexed++ and _, _, err = s.build(...) where totalBatchesIndexed and err are outer variables shared by all workers. With initWorkers > 1 this is concurrent unsynchronized read-modify-write and concurrent writes to the same err variable. It triggers the race detector, corrupts the indexed count reported in the span, and can lose or overwrite build errors so group.Wait returns the wrong error.

findings.title: TotalDocs iterates cache map without lock while builds write concurrently
findings.body: bleveBackend.BuildIndex now only holds cacheMu for the final cache insert so many builds run in parallel, and GetIndex uses RLock. TotalDocs loops over b.cache with no lock at all. Concurrent iteration with concurrent map writes is a data race and can panic with concurrent map iteration and map write. It is called at the end of init and can run concurrently with on-demand builds from Search or watch events.

findings.title: Search watch goroutine leaks and panics on closed channel
findings.body: searchSupport.init creates watchctx as context.Background with a comment new context and then runs for { v := <-events; s.handleEvent(watchctx, v) } with no ok check and no exit on cancellation. When the sql backend poller exits it closes the channel, so receives return nil forever. handleEvent dereferences evt.Type and evt.Key and will panic on nil, otherwise it busy-loops. The Background context is never cancelled so the goroutine also leaks on shutdown and loses tracing and admin claims.

findings.title: Stop shutdown guard is dead after removing lazy Init checks
findings.body: server.Stop sets s.initErr to service is stopping/stopped to make future calls fail. Previously every RPC called s.Init which returned that stored error. This PR removes all Init calls from Create, Update, Delete, Read, List, Watch, Search, History, Origin, IsHealthy, PutBlob and GetBlob. Nothing now reads the value written by Stop, so the server keeps serving new requests after Stop instead of rejecting them, breaking graceful shutdown.

findings.title: Check-then-act race allows duplicate builds for same index
findings.body: getOrCreateIndex does GetIndex and if nil calls build without per-key singleflight. Previously bleve BuildIndex held a global lock for the whole build so duplicates were serialized. Now it only locks the final map insert. Two goroutines for the same NamespacedResource from parallel init, Search, or watch handling can both see nil and both run ListIterator plus bleve.New. This wastes work, double-increments IndexTenants and IndexedKinds metrics, leaks the loser index with last-writer-wins, and for file-backed indexes concurrently creates the same directory which fails with index already exists or lock contention.

findings.title: Eager Init blocks NewResourceServer on full index build
findings.body: NewResourceServer now calls s.Init synchronously, which runs lifecycle init plus full search index build over all namespaces before returning. The PR description says the build takes too long for a gRPC context. Doing it synchronously in the constructor moves the same long blocking work to startup, delaying readiness and risking startup timeouts. On error it returns nil without calling the cancel func for the internal context, leaking that context.

findings.title: Trace context still discarded in bleve BuildIndex
findings.body: The PR claims to fix trace propagation by keeping the Start context, and search.go and GetResourceStats were changed to ctx, span. bleveBackend.BuildIndex still does _, span := tracer.Start and discards the child context, so the builder callback and ListIterator inside the build are not children of the BuildIndex span. The same pattern remains in sql backend WriteEvent, ReadResource and ListIterator, so propagation is only partially fixed.

findings.title: Postgres storage-server test skipped instead of fixed
findings.body: The change adds a skip for GRAFANA_TEST_DB=postgres in TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer with a TODO. This removes integration coverage for the storage server target on postgres, so regressions in the unified storage startup path on postgres will not be caught in CI.
